model_years: Year 1 through 10 are successive 12-month scenarios after the 20 Nov 2026 entry price. Opening financial state is 30 Sep 2026 and is not rolled forward for the unreported 51-day gap. No extrapolation is labeled remaining FY27.

facts.price_source: P9 official NSE EQ close, ISIN INE752E01010
facts.share_source: P4 consolidated EPS note, 9,300,603,819 actual shares
facts.reported_debt_scope: Gross current and noncurrent borrowings, excluding lease liabilities. Scenario gross debt is not net debt. Reported cash held static, not spent or accumulated.

assumption_evidence_and_limits.80_20: P4 printed notice p14 describes intended FY28 debt mobilisation/internal-resource split. It does not disclose each SPV actual leverage or promise future loans. Model applies 80:20 as reference financing assumption for new TBCB assets, not factual bid terms.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.70_30: P8 Reg18 normative cost-plus debt/equity. This is distinct from actual TBCB debt.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.roe: 15% regulated posttax base rate applies current 2024-29 block. Continuation beyond 2029 is an assumption. TBCB 10/13/16% are explicit first-year accounting return on original 20% reference equity, not actual project IRRs.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.pat_normalization: Base 15000 is close to twice H1 FY27 PAT 14929.16. Reported TTM 16195.87 carries FY26 tax/regulatory remeasurement. Sensitivity restores it. Neither is a perfectly audited through-cycle normalized figure.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.capex: All-in asset spending scenarios include capitalized interest. 3000 annual sustaining capex is an analyst assumption because the issuer does not publish a complete sustaining/growth cash split.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.cash: Zero base working-capital release prevents repeatedly harvesting H1 receivable collections. Cash proxy excludes detailed tax/regulatory timing and lease-accounting differences. Sensitivity consumes 2000 each year.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.capitalization: 11/89 regulated/TBCB mix approximates current work in hand. Future award mix is unknown. Commissioning uses half-year contributions, no early-completion bonus.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.new_assets: 3.5% depreciation and 15-year loan amortization are simplifying assumptions. Regulatory depreciation and actual financing are asset-specific. TBCB tariff and pre-interest economics held constant in real nominal modeled amounts, with only debt-amortization interest saving.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.existing_assets: Aggregate legacy PAT includes legacy financing and normative interest recovery, so legacy debt repayment itself does not create artificial retained tariff profits. No legacy interest saving is separately added.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.funding: Reference principal is not a committed debt maturity schedule. Actual debt closes the cash equation, with after-tax interest on deviations from the reference schedule. The leverage ceiling is an analyst scenario constraint, not a bank covenant.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.future_funding: Gross borrowing is assumed accessible at scenario rates, subject to illustrative leverage ceiling and future approvals. P4 current 220000 borrowing authorisation cannot be treated as permanent. No asset monetisation or equity issuance is assumed.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.dividends: 55% base/upside payout and 50% adverse are assumptions subject to funding ceiling, with annual end-year receipt timing. The already ex-record-date INR3 dividend is excluded from entry value.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.shares: Fixed actual share count throughout. A rights/equity issue would require separate funding and dilution mechanics. No personal portfolio sizing is implied.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.not_a_full_forecast: Cohort and funding sensitivity, not an all-project signed loan/tariff model, covenant forecast or probability-weighted expected return.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.cash_balance: Gross debt starts from gross reported borrowings. Cash of 2520.91, of which 1809.18 is restricted to specific projects, is held constant. No cash deduction is made in primary leverage ratios. Net debt illustrations distinguish all cash from only unrestricted cash.
assumption_evidence_and_limits.legacy_rate_scope: Legacy PAT embeds its existing financing and tariff recovery. Rate stresses fully affect new TBCB reference loans and excess group financing, but do not fully reprice every legacy floating-rate, foreign-currency or fixed-rate debt instrument. The stress therefore is not a complete interest-rate exposure model.

humnabad_assumptions.status: Project construction cost, loan terms, contract escalation and concession duration were not verified. Costs and all economic parameters except quoted annual charges are illustrative, not estimates of the actual award.
